summary: Zenflow said Monday it has raised $52 million and partnered with Cook Medical to facilitate the commercialization of a urology device. The agreements support the Zenflow Spring system, a treatment for benign prostatic hyperplasia that received Food and Drug Administration approval in December. Zenflow’s device has a different design from the BPH treatments offered by Boston Scientific, Olympus and Teleflex to bridge the gap between medicines and more invasive procedures.
